title: From Defender to Devil? Unintended Risk Interactions Induced by LLM Defenses

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cognitive bias recognition using the StereoSet dataset (error rate in distinguishing stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical concepts), assessing attitudinal bias agreement using the CrowS-Pairs dataset (rate of explicit agreement with stereotypical sentences), and measuring behavioral failure to refuse queries containing embedded social stereotypes using the Do-Not-Answer dataset.

Evaluating the performance and cross-risk interactions of specific fairness-defended models (e.g., DAMA model editing and Mistral models fine-tuned with SFT/DPO) that were specifically trained to mitigate gender-related stereotypes.
